Operating Environment

Open Beta

Quest 3

Via Virtual Desktop – Wireless connection

Situation

Approximately 20 hours

Previously, my right hand would not move at all,

so I was unable to open menus etc. using the ‘USE’ gesture,

which meant I had to rely on hand tracking or one-handed operation.

Quest behaviour: SteamVR screen? It is possible to display the Quest screen.

In that state, I have confirmed that the controller is functioning normally.

Steps to Reproduce

Workaround

None

Steps to Reproduce

Quest 3

→ Virtual Desktop

→ Wireless connection

→ Launch SteamVR

→ Launch VRChat

→ Play as normal

→ Allow approximately 20 hours to elapse

→ One of the hands becomes locked in the ‘USE’ pose of its own accord
